observations: ss.cc.getc4 calculates c4 from gamma functions.
ss.cc.getd2 and ss.cc.getd3 calculate range-distribution constants numerically.
ss.cc implements moving-range control charts; this fixture does not claim that SixSigma emits StatPro Xbar-R results.
limitations: The d2 and d3 entries are three-decimal published reference values, so derived factor comparisons use the declared tolerance.
R was not installed in the validation environment; this is a source-derived fixture, not captured R runtime output.
The fixture establishes an independent coefficient cross-check, not product equivalence with R SixSigma or Minitab.
